justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/Nodes.java, src/main/java/org/jsoup/nodes/Element.java, src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/Collector.java, src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/Elements.java, src/main/java/org/jsoup/nodes/NodeUtils.java, src/main/java/org/jsoup/parser/Parser.java, and src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/Selector.java. Nodes is a small ArrayList wrapper with limited fan-out (ArrayList plus Validate/StringUtil and direct DOM calls on Node/Element). Its production fan-in is narrow: Elements extends it, Collector only creates it via Nodes::new, and Element exposes 4 selectNodes methods returning it; the other occurrences are Javadoc/comments and tests. This does not match a hub-like dependency pattern.
